title: Daily Life Paragraph
titleMy: နေ့စဉ်ဘဝအကြောင်း စာပိုဒ်
description: Type a paragraph about daily life. Focus on smooth flow.

exercises.instruction: I wake up at six in the morning and brush my teeth. Then I eat breakfast and take the bus to work. I return home in the evening and watch a little television.
